scenarioName: Within weekly flex band is OK
description: A basket that keeps the week inside the +/-10% flex band reconciles to Ok with no approval needed.

input.userMessage: Reconcile a 140.00 basket against the weekly target of 140 with nothing spent yet this week or cycle.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BudgetVerdict with outcome Ok and RequiresApproval false.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: Projected weekly total within target + flex and cycle under cap must produce Ok.

scoring.passCriteria: Verdict is Ok and the summary confirms it is within the flex band.
